pages.title: GTA 6 - Paradise Lost Trophy - Complete Chapter 1 by Josie
pages.meat: We're giving away more prizes to players who have finished the Logitech G PRO Pass! ## Overview To get the Paradise Lost Trophy, you must complete Chapter 1 of the story, the trophy is unmissable with natural progression. **Important to note:** During Chapter 1, there are a few things that you must make sure of before making it to Chapter 2 as there will be a point of no return at the end of the chapter. **Missable:** Make sure that you are taking part in the meditation with Lucia in Chapter 1 at Jason's place, she will talk about wanting to clear her head, make sure that you join her for this Meditation spot. There is also the opportunity to launch all three games on the JoySystem when playing it as part of the story with Cal at Jason's place, 2 games launch automatically, but launching the third on the console has to be done manually. If you don't do this here, you will have to launch the game later on, I will remind you of this again in Chapter 3. Still need help with other trophies? Check out the main page: ## Paradise Lost Trophy Progress all the way through Chapter 1, until you are walking into the hospital as Lucia. Once you make it to the hospital, head inside and go left and up the stairs to the first floor. Once you make it to the next Reception desk, head through the white double doors at the back. Through here, talk with one of the nurses and ask for "John Doe", she will direct you to the room where Jason is. After the cutscene, Lucia will take Jason out of the room in a wheelchair, you will be stopped by one of the nurses, but you need to keep an eye on the guy coming through the white double doors, be ready to take him out as Jason. (He will remain in the wheelchair) Once he is dealt with, Lucia will not stop walking so be ready for the upcoming enemies and take these out also, she will wheel Jason into an elevator and you will take this together. After taking the elevator, Lucia will keep walking again, you will have to be quick in taking out the enemies along the way. Upcoming, you will get jumped by an enemy and will have to defend yourself as Lucia. After the cutscene, Lucia will be dragging Jason, and you will need to take out the enemies through the glass as Jason to protect both he and Lucia. Keep progressing until Jason is back in the wheelchair and you have to take on more enemies throughout the hospital. Keep progressing until you switch back to Lucia and start shooting at all the enemies in the darker hospital area, you will need to defend Jason here. Keep going until you make it into the colourful corridor area, here, be careful not to shoot innocent civilians, only take on the enemies. Keep progressing through the hospital remembering not to shoot the innocent. After the next short cutscene, Lucia and Jason will split up, Lucia will go to find a ride out of there, meanwhile Jason is still in the wheelchair. He will get jumped by an enemy, you will have to defend yourself here. Keep doing so until Lucia brings the ride to escape. The next segment will be a chase scene, where you are shooting the enemies chasing you as Jason from the back of the Ambulance truck. The chase sequence is over once you make it over the railway and the oncoming train stops the enemies from chasing you further. There will be many cutscenes upcoming so keep on enjoying the story, you will then wake up as Jason in a Motel room, Lucia will come over and as her, you will both be looking through the contents of the case you have. Once you have looked over everything, you will have control of Lucia in the Motel room, and here is where the Paradise Lost Trophy will pop, signifying the completion of Chapter 1.

pages.title: GTA 6 - T**s Ass Drug Money Trophy - Complete Chapter 2 by Josie
pages.meat: To get the **T\*\*s Ass Drug Money** Trophy, you must complete Chapter 2 of the story, the trophy is unmissable with natural progression. Still need help with other trophies? Check out the main page: Once you have completed all of the main objectives in Chapter 2, you will be called to head back to the Motel, once you enter the bathroom of the Motel Room will show VC, to progress to Vice City. After opening the bathroom door, there will be a series of cutscenes, once these are done, you will have to make your way through the car park of the Motel, taking out all of the enemies here. Once these are all defeated, make your way to Lucia in the Motel Diner, from here you will have to continue defending yourself. After taking out all the enemies, you will exit the Motel Diner and separately take vehicles, Jason will be in a car, Lucia on a bike. As Lucia, proceed to follow Jason during the chase scene. After following Jason, you will need to jump off of the bike and into the car, after this, there will be a further chase scene where as Lucia, you will be shooting at enemy cars. After this, there will be cutscenes, and you will have made it into Vice City in the dark. On the drive, Jason will call Dre'Quan, he will give you directions on how to get to his club. Once you arrive, you will need to enter in through the back entrance, there will be a cutscene in meeting up with Dre'Quan. Once inside, you can choose to take or decline the cash for the strippers, but you will need to make your way upstairs to continue. Finish everything in the club and after the cutscenes, you will be back outside, head back around to your car to make it to the new apartment. Once you make it to the apartment, head inside for the final cutscene, once Jason and Lucia wake up the following morning, the T\*\*s Ass Drugs Money Trophy will pop.

Simply hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on map) while being chased by police the entire time. You'll want to maintain the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level). Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs (bought at Ammu-Nations) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner. Then loot 3 shops in a row. This trophy is for returning later in the game and robbing the same store again as Lucia, then getting away on foot (not in a vehicle). And for trying every one of them once, you’ll unlock the ‘Master of None’ trophy. First things first, according to the trophy there are only 9 activities in GTA VI, although the game bundles a load of them together, like all the racing categories (which are clearly 3 or so, but they’ve made them 1). Secondly, they’ve just not included some activities like Meditation Spots, which is bizarre. So, you need to try each of the below activities (there is a caveat below, however). The 9 tracked activities are: - Fishing - Hunting - Golf - Basketball - Pool - Racing (whether it’s traditional racing, Race Challenges or Top Fun Drone time trials) - Shooting Ranges - Video Games - Base Jump Just as an FYI too, for instance, you actually have to complete the Base Jump, and get within Par Time – we did multiple Base Jumps, multiple times across multiple places, but the trophy only unlocked when we hit the Par Time on one of them. pages.meat: # The Shootist Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI | PlayStationTrophies.org URL: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/trophy/the-shootist.html The Shootist Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI | PlayStationTrophies.org # The Shootist Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI - #### The Shootist Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. ## How to unlock The Shootist One of the activities you can get involved in while wandering around Leonida is taking on some of the local Shooting Range challenges. There are two Shooting Ranges in Leonida: - Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range – This can be found to the northeast of Port Gellhorn, where you spend Chapter 2. There are 24 gold medals on offer here. - Griffin Shooting Range – This one is on the outskirts of Vice City, in the heart of Leonida. On the northwest side of Vice City is a district called Balsero. He'll want you to go and visit him at his place way up in the north of Leonida. There he runs his successful hunting business, and he'll get you set up to go out hunting. A short while into completing his “Target Decks” you’ll get a message about a Snapmatic Animal – AKA a legendary animal. The first one you receive is the Snapmatic Buck, and the text reads… “Hey Duval. So I took a handful of mushrooms a few nights back and went for a run around Grayson. Saw some crazy stuff that might not have been real, but I also saw this deer that had huge ass antlers and I think that might’ve been real. pages.meat: # Catch Me If You Can Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI | PlayStationTrophies.org URL: https://www.playstationtrophies.org/game/grand-theft-auto-6/trophy/catch-me-if-you-can.html Catch Me If You Can Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI | PlayStationTrophies.org # Catch Me If You Can Trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI - #### Catch Me If You Can Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. ## How to unlock Catch Me If You Can It wouldn’t be GTA if you didn’t wade into an airport and steal a commercial airliner, and that’s exactly what this trophy rewards you for. First things first, VCIA can be found in west Vice City itself – it’s huge, you can’t miss it. And secondly, you can’t just grab any ol’ plane for this one. Oh no. You have to grab one of the huge double-decker airliners that's docked at one of the gates. You know you’re in the right plane when you enter via the tunnel used to board people onto planes, and then if you have to go upstairs to get into the pilot cabin. The plane is a Bottcher 020 – we first tried it with the Bottcher 015A, but that didn’t work. Once you’ve done that, back it up, and fly it out of the airport and the ‘Catch Me If You Can’ trophy is all yours. A word of advice, though: sure you can race through the gates and drive to one of the planes, but you’ll attract a 4 star Wanted Level instantly. Or, you could go to the car park near the terminals, climb to the 5th floor, and then drop onto the top of the passenger tunnel that people use to get from the car park to departures. Then you can climb the rooftops all the way to the plane itself. We did this and it was only when we pulled onto the runway to take off that the 4 star level popped up. If you fight your way in, you’ll get peppered with bullets while you’re trying to reverse and take off. So, first things first, the military base, known as Mile Zero Air Base, can be found to the far south of Leonida, in an area called Goose Key – to the west of Southwind, a small town. To get into the military base, you can fly through the gates in a car, use the Unique Stunt Jump to the southwest to get over the fence, or, you can use the easiest way, which is to use the helicopter on the helipad to the south of Southwind, where there's pretty much always a chopper there. There you'll find loads of Rhino tanks and APCs too – and not a lot of resistance if you're quick. There are various different pop-ups you can get, and they include: - Professional Action – Yellow devil symbol – You’ll get these if you complete robberies without any casualties, make a clean getaway, make yourself incognito and more. Anything where you limit damage and chaos generally gives you this, like disabling an alarm before and destroying footage – of which you get 1 point for each. - Hardened Action - Orange devil symbol – If you do end up in combat, you’ll get a Hardened pop-up if you don’t kill someone, but you incapacitate them – AKA shoot them in the knee. - Violent Action - Purple devil symbol – If you kill a cop or a civilian needlessly, you’ll get a Violent Action pop-up. This can include shooting a fleeing civilian, running over people and more. - Psycho Action- Light purple devil symbol with red eyes – This is an escalation of the previous action. If you kill lots of cops, murder lots of defenceless citizens, and kill vulnerable animals like cats and dogs, you’ll get this pop-up. Yes, even if you accidentally run them over! Eek! So, to unlock the ‘Actions Speak Louder’ trophy, you need to get 500 of these pop-ups. It’s obviously a lot easier to get a headshot kill or run over a civilian and get a Violent Action pop-up than it is a Professional Action, but they all count. You’ll likely unlock this by just going for 100%, especially with how many banks, stores and Illegal Operations you have to complete. If not, you can repeat the same Illegal Operations and bank jobs over and over again. Or, you can just plough through a load of cats. You also need to launder $250,000 in Marked Bills for 100% too. So, from that alone, fly past $250,000 (we got $130,000 on just one bank job earlier) – that’s provided you get out safely and can get to Yasmani in Little Cuba in Vice City, that is – you meet Yasmani in the 12th mission of Chapter 3, “Boobie Time,” by the way. So, to do this, hit banks and payday loan companies, and then take the Marked Bills back to Yasmani. Don’t take it anywhere else, as you won’t get the true value for it. If you also hit the Payday Loans places as part of Yasmani’s “Payday Loans Jobs” optional missions, you’ll get even more value out of your robbery attempts. Now, you can either get garages and store registered cars in there, or you can register and then sell if you’re struggling for space.
